The method

The TWS method: you learn by doing.

Task based classes in real Brazilian scenarios. You walk out of every single class able to do something new in Portuguese.

1

You learn by doing

Every class is built around a real task: arriving, ordering, asking, meeting people. Grammar serves the mission, never the other way around.

2

Real Brazil, not a textbook

Slang, shortcuts, the way people actually talk and text. The Portuguese you will really hear on the street and in the group chat.

3

Clear "I can" promises

Each module ends with a real can-do. By the end of the course: I can survive and connect in Brazil, on my own.

4

Checkpoints keep it honest

Short check ins show you what actually stuck, so your progress is something you can feel, not just hope for.

Where you start

Pick your starting point.

Beginners get real structure. Everyone gets a teacher who tailors the ride to your life and your goals.

Izzy, somewhere on the road
Your teacher

Hi, I'm Izzy.

I'm from Recife, home of the best Carnaval in the world and a healthy respect for sharks. I finished a marketing degree in 2012, traded the corporate suits for a backpack, and never really unpacked.

South America down to Ushuaia. Two years in Buenos Aires on a diet of Malbec and alfajores. Then two years photographing cruise ships across the Mediterranean and the Caribbean, through the Panama Canal. A beer in Munich turned into accidentally living in Berlin for three years. Now I'm back in Brazil, far too social for an office cubicle.

I learned Spanish, English and German as an adult, so I know exactly how it feels to be the one smiling and nodding without a clue. That is the whole reason this school exists.

TEFL & TESOL certified7+ years living abroad3 languages learned as an adult

Good questions

Before you say 'oi'.

Do I need to know any Portuguese?

No. Voyager starts from absolute zero, from your very first 'oi'. If you can read this page, you are ready.

Brazilian or European Portuguese?

Brazilian, and the real spoken kind. The Portuguese you will actually use here, on the street and with real people.

Are the classes live or recorded?

Live, with me, in a small group. If you have to miss one, you get the recording so you never fall behind.

I'm too busy, too old, or bad at languages.

You are exactly who this is for. I learned three languages as an adult while moving countries. We go at a human pace and build habits that actually stick.

How do I join?

Send me a DM with the word VOYAGER on Instagram. We have a quick chat, I get to know your goals, and I help you start in the right place.

Ready to feel at home in Brazil?

The founding group is small on purpose, so everyone gets real attention. Let's talk before the seats fill up.
